snippet.title: GHOSTCAM | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Witness, if you dare, a brand-new gameplay trailer for GHOST CAM, a VR paranormal investigation thriller full of intrigue, mystery and, well, ghosts! This fresh trailer lifts the sheet on a whole camcorder’s worth of new footage, puzzle mechanics, poltergeists and haunted oddities. 

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121930/GHOST_CAM/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
